conditions.condition_text: Wait for the previous 4-hour candle to close bullish (for long) or bearish (for short) to establish bias.
The bias is set by the close of the preceding 4-hour candle.
On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break the high (for long) or low (for short) of the current 4-hour candle.
The break of the candle high/low serves as the entry trigger.
Ensure the entry candle is not an indecision candle or a hammer, and if a wick is present, it must be at the bottom for a long entry.
Candle quality is required to avoid trading in indecision or rejection zones.
The strategy requires the market to be trending, not ranging.
Price must break out of sideways areas and show strong 4-hour candle movement.
The entry candle must have a clean body close, avoiding indecision or rejection wicks.
The stop loss is calculated dynamically based on the average range of the previous few 4-hour candles.
The speaker aims for a 1:2 risk to reward ratio.
